_what: Curated SUBJECT tags for the PCM design catalog: what each design actually depicts.
_provenance: HAND-CURATED BY LOOKING AT THE IMAGES. This is the one file in the PCM catalog
pipeline that is NOT derived from the books' text. The design books print a design
number and a section heading and nothing else - no keywords, no captions - so there is
no text source that says design 1188 is a dogwood branch. Every entry in designTags was
recorded by rendering pcm-design-images/**.webp into 30 contact sheets (24 designs each,
at the images' native 357x205, built by scripts/pcm_contact_sheets.py) and reading them
one sheet at a time, writing down what is drawn on each marker.
Consequence: this file is SOURCE, not output. Re-running scripts/pcm_extract.py must
never overwrite it, and a design added to the books later will have no tags until
somebody looks at it - scripts/pcm_tags.py fails loudly when that happens.
elementRules is different in kind: the 2019 Design Elements book DOES name every
ornament (BASS 001, ROSE 014, ARMY 003), so element tags are derived from those names
plus the curated stem->extra-tag table below. Curation there is only the semantic lift -
knowing that a BASS is a fish you catch and that ARMY means military service.
Tagged 2026-08-02 for sprint-11 Track E2 (subject search).
_how_to_extend: 1. Add the design id to designTags with a space-separated tag list.
2. Every tag must already exist in vocabulary, or add it there with a one-line gloss.
3. If families would say a different word for it, add that word to synonyms.

vocabulary.flower: any flower or floral spray, species not called out
vocabulary.floral-spray: a loose cut-flower arrangement rather than a border
vocabulary.wreath: a closed ring of foliage or flowers
vocabulary.garland: a swag or arch of flowers
vocabulary.animal: an animal, kind not called out
vocabulary.banner: a banner or scroll bearing text
vocabulary.child: a child's marker or a child in the scene
vocabulary.portrait: a photo portrait is part of the design
vocabulary.border: the ornament IS a border or frame
vocabulary.ledger: a full-length ledger, not a flat marker
vocabulary.organization: a lodge, club or fraternal emblem

elementRules._note: Element tags = slug(stem) + categoryTags[category] + stemExtras[stem]. The stem is the element code with its trailing number stripped: BASS 001 -> BASS.
